newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada T-bills open firmer as currency strengthens.
newsitem.headline: Canada T-bills open firmer as currency strengthens.

text.p: Canadian T-bills opened firmer in moderate trade on Friday, with a stronger dollar and a continued shortage of certain issues of T-bills helping send prices higher, dealers said.

"The Canadian dollar is certainly helping things out here," said one T-bill dealer with a Canadian bank. "There's huge demand for bills in every area. There's technical things happening with all the short squeezes that are going on."
Canada's three-month when-issued T-bill firmed to yield 3.10 percent from 3.12 percent at the close of trading on Thursday.

The Canadian dollar strengthened on Friday after the release of Canada's composite leading indicator for July. The currency strengthened to as far as C$1.3865 (US$0.7212) from Thursday's close of C$1.3902 (US$0.7184).
Dealers said the strength in the dollar reduced the likelihood that the Bank of Canada would soon hike rates, because a firmer dollar had the effect of tightening monetary conditions.
A shortage of some issues continued to plague the money market, dealers said. This week saw a major squeeze in the one-year portion of the curve.

The situation was so bad the Bank of Canada reopened the issue to add C$500 million in supply. Dealers said there is now a squeeze for three-month cash T-bills, causing a twelve basis point spread between the cash and when-issued T-bills.

"The short end is always so well bid because there's so much money now in the funds that's looking for a hiding place until they like the stock market better and it's just an immense demand. That's really got our market cooking," the dealer said.
In other prices, the six-month when-issued T-bill firmed to yield 3.59 percent from 3.62 percent on Thursday.
The one-year when-issued T-bill firmed to yield 4.0 percent from 4.01 percent.
The call loan or overnight lending rate traded at 3.30 percent, near the center of the Bank of Canada's 3.0-3.5 percent target range.
